name: org.realitydeslab.body-oracle
description:
Body Oracle turns body poses into oracle-bone-inspired characters with an on-device YOLO pose model (Unity Inference Engine) and shows them through the HoloKit Unity SDK on iPhone (Mono and HoloKit Stereo) or with a Mac webcam.

Contains the app's scripts, scenes, model, character sprites, pronunciation audio, shaders, the macOS native plug-in and the validation tools.
